infographics.title: KYC Is a Production Chain, Not a Chat Prompt
infographics.subtitle: AI can help with extraction. Production KYC still needs screening, auditability, exception routing, and monitoring.

steps.label: Collect identity evidence
steps.note: User documents, forms, and declared profile data enter the flow.

steps.label: Extract and normalize fields
steps.note: Names, dates, addresses, IDs, and entity fields become structured data.

steps.label: Screen the profile
steps.note: Sanctions, PEP, adverse media, and internal risk lists.

steps.label: Check authenticity and liveness
steps.note: Document integrity, selfie or liveness signals, and tamper checks.

steps.label: Link behavior and counterparties
steps.note: Accounts, external relationships, counterparties, and transaction behavior connect to risk logic.

steps.label: Route exceptions to review
steps.note: Humans handle the cases the system should not auto-clear.

steps.label: Preserve the audit trail
steps.note: Every decision needs regulator-readable evidence and replayable reasoning.

steps.label: Monitor after onboarding
steps.note: Risk does not stop when the account opens. Behavior keeps changing.

infographics.caption: The hard part is not extracting a name from a document. The hard part is making a decision chain that survives audit, exceptions, and time.

infographics.title: Where the AML Engine Actually Fits
infographics.subtitle: AI demos mostly cover the front door. Production KYC lives in the layers after that.

segments.label: What AI demos cover
segments.note: Useful, but not enough to make a regulated decision.

segments.label: What production KYC needs
segments.note: This is where compliance, evidence, and operational risk live.

highlights.label: AML Engine scope
highlights.description: Behavior, counterparties, account links, and transaction risk.

highlights.label: AML Engine scope
highlights.description: Ongoing monitoring after onboarding, where static KYC becomes live risk.

infographics.caption: Claude can help shape the front-end intelligence. The AML Engine belongs where risk becomes behavioral and evidence has to persist.
